newsitem.title: USA: Audi sets prices for new A4 sedan in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Audi sets prices for new A4 sedan in U.S..

text.p: Audi of America Inc said Wednesday its new Audi A4 T sports sedan with a 1.8 liter engine will go on sale in the United States in November with a starting price of $23,490, including delivery charges.

The new A4, which has a four-cylinder engine, comes one year after Audi introduced its popular A4 with a six-cylinder engine. The 1997 Audi A4 with a 2.8 liter, six-cylinder engine, will start at $27,930 after delivery charges, up 3.5 percent.
Standard equipment on the new A4 1.8 T version includes anti-lock brakes, automatic climate control, stereo cassette, an anti-theft alarm system and central locking.

Audi, a unit of Volkswagen AG, said sticker prices for its 1997 models will rise an average of 2.1 percent from the most recent 1996 model prices. Delivery charges for all 1997 models rose to $500 from $475.
Prices on all 1997 models are up except for the new Cabriolet, which will start at $35,100, down six percent from the previous price. Audi said the base model is being repositioned as a value leader.
